fusions.name: Burst from Below
fusions.desc: A sudden spring on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It is always a critical hit and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Toxic Gape
fusions.desc: A snapping bite that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Venomed Rebuke
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Dive for Cover
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 18% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 40 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 6%.
